The '''Basan system''' was located in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim's]] [[Churba sector/Legends|Churba sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the origin point of the group known as the [[Basani high priest]]s.<ref name="Order66" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Basan [[Star system/Legends|system]] was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square P-15.<ref name="TEA" />
